text: Controls: the HVAC shall have a local controller per package with a serial link to the DCS (alarms for chiller trip, low pressure of a room, filter differential pressure, fan failure, high room temperature 3 K above the set point and smoke detection), automatic changeover of standby equipment, remote start and stop from the control room for the essential ventilation, and time delay restart after a power failure; the room temperature and pressure signals of the control and electrical rooms shall be hard-wired to the DCS.
